migration_renumber_note: Proposed 20261004_0033 follows landed #70 revision 20261003_0032. The integration owner must recheck the active Alembic head at merge time.
required_api_budget: create_app(epic_brainstorm_budget=TaskBudget(...)) enables the proposed API service with an explicit bounded discovery budget.
worker_gateway_and_reader_factory_bindin: run_worker(brainstorm_gateway_factory=..., brainstorm_reader_factory=...) requires both subject-specific factories together and uses settings.subscription_quota_policy. The gateway implements execute(snapshot, persisted_turns, controlled_reader, cancelled=..., lifecycle=...).
genuine_supervised_receipts: Genuine supervised subprocess receipts (ClientProcessReceipt) under ClientProcessSupervisor with fail-closed authority, no fake delivery run, and no paid provider fallback.

integration_limits.actual_producer_vs_fixture: Tests use actual landed #69 producer code in disposable overlays, including main after #70. Shared production files remain integration-owned.
integration_limits.live_integration: Providerless peer tests run in-process or via supervisor subprocess; live CLI/broker gateway and production repository reader factories remain integration-owned.
integration_limits.proposal_policy: Publish proposals only as data artifacts; never apply them to shared production source.
